main.description: A post: long-form text first. Posts are create-only; the AppView keeps the first version it indexes and ignores later updates. There is no repost record and no quote embed: Authentiq has no reshares.

text.description: The post's text. At most 3000 graphemes (and 30000 UTF-8 bytes). Must not be blank.

facets.description: Mentions and links in the text, as UTF-8 byte ranges.

community.description: The sh.authentiq.community.declaration this post is written into. Top-level posts only: a reply belongs to its root's community, and a reply that sets this is dropped by the AppView.

embed.description: Open union; only external link cards exist so far.

replyRef.description: Where a reply sits: the thread's first post (root) and the post it answers (parent). For a direct reply to the root, both are the same strongRef.
